item.title: Rallying Cry – November 15, 2026
item.description: From a Taiwanese farmer reviving climate-resilient millet to Mark Carney pledging $560 million for Brazil’s forests and Hannah Fry celebrating her recovery from cervical cancer, today’s news is packed with hope and progress.
